part.text: {"scores":[{"criterion":"stakes","value":3,"ref":"card:limits","reason":"Outcomes decide whether to MD-verify before synthesis, but only single-phase ranking under one force field is checked; no synthesis, dielectric or stability reality step."},{"criterion":"lever","value":5,"ref":"plan:compute_axis","reason":"100→1000 candidates is 10x compute alone; pools, force field and temperature fixed; predicted Spearman gap exceeds bootstrapped noise with 3x-length rerun check."},{"criterion":"verifiable","value":5,"ref":"plan:scored_against","reason":"Scored against published measured viscosities of Ester 1/2 and Novec 649 datasheet values, never predictors; anchor phase reproduces 6.41 cSt within ±25% first."},{"criterion":"open","value":5,"ref":"card:left_open","reason":"Closest prior (Org-Mol) stopped at ML ranking with two synthesized esters and no MD verification; the 100-to-1000 MD-verification range is explicitly stated as untested."},{"criterion":"reshape","value":5,"ref":"plan:restructuring","reason":"Names the sequential trajectory dependency, replaces it with same-time parallel replicas, requires a replica-agreement condition measured in the anchor phase before the main spend."},{"criterion":"baseline","value":4,"ref":"plan:restructuring.baseline_sequential","reason":"Sequential 45 ns run is tuned with full-GPU mdrun flags and both baselines are timed in anchor, but parallel-vs-sequential equality is checked only as 3-vs-6 replicas."}],"decides_by":"verify_300","decides_by_reason":"Decision rule needs the 300-candidate Spearman and figure-climb values, produced only after verify_300; earlier gates depend on anchor-phase measurements, not the outcome of interest."}
